description: W.A. Albert & Nine Other Petitioners v. Chief Secretary, Southern Province & Others W.A. Albert & Nine Other Petitioners v. Chief Secretary, Southern Province & Others View More before Hon. P. Padman Surasena, J
parties: W.A. Albert & Nine Other Petitioners v. Chief Secretary, Southern Province & Others W.A. Albert & Nine Other Petitioners v. Chief Secretary, Southern Province & Others View More
keywords: Ten writ applications decided by one judgment – Retired public officers – Administrative Appeals Tribunal – Supernumerary promotions converted to permanent promotions retrospectively – Applications for concessionary motor-vehicle permits after retirement – Trade and Investment Policy Circular – Circular applicable to officers in active service – Incorrect particulars suggesting active service – Vehicle permits issued contrary to applicable circular – Public authority entitled to treat manifestly illegal action as nullity – No duty to afford hearing before correcting manifest illegality – All applications dismissed without costs.
legistation: Constitution – Article 140; Trade and Investment Policy Circular No. 01/2013 dated 02.08.2013; earlier circular dated 30.03.2007 and amendment dated 04.03.2008 discussed; Administrative Appeals Tribunal proceedings.
